changelog:
- fix(accounts): the QR capture screen no longer renders the legacy login-address/paste panel beside it — once the relayed screenshot arrives only the scan view stays, and hosts with no Chrome keep the paste fallback
- fix(accounts): plugin credential updates carrying numbers (mimo-desktop's sts_renewed_at epoch millis) are persisted instead of being discarded — the missing half of the scan-to-chat fix that left freshly minted sessions unsaved
- companion marketplace release mimo-desktop 2.1.3 mints the app session on the first probe after a capture, so scanned accounts serve chat immediately
